nodes.label: Pantheon
nodes.description: 6 gods: Auris (Dawnbringer/Penitent split), Morthis, Veth, Dara, The Wanderer, Kael and Mira; religious movements including Restorers, Dusk Keepers, Architects of the True Dawn

nodes.label: Auris (Dawnbringer)
nodes.description: God of dawn; Penitent/Wounded split schism; Restorers claim Auris demands the ritual be completed; central to religious tension

nodes.label: Morthis (Usher)
nodes.description: God of death and passage; relevant to Dawnborn sacrifice theme
